# Ziggurat of Enki
# Chivalric registry for the Knights of the Ziggurat

> This site records a knighthood conferred on 13 October 2000 and a new chivalric charter dated 4 November 2026. It does not claim membership in the orders named in the history notes.

- [Claims](https://zigguratofenki.org/claims): What is documented and what is not claimed
- [The 2000 act](https://zigguratofenki.org/2000): OSMTH dubbing of 13 October 2000
- [Charter](https://zigguratofenki.org/charter): Knights of the Ziggurat, dated 4 November 2026
- [Knights Roll](https://zigguratofenki.org/knights): Public register of invested members
- [The Work](https://zigguratofenki.org/work): Chivalric theurgy and planetary balance
- [FAQ](https://zigguratofenki.org/faq): Short questions and answers
